title: Add water to a nitrile
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Acidic hydrolysis of a nitrile gives a carboxylic acid after workup. The nitrile carbon becomes the carboxyl carbon, so the carbon count stays at two.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of acetonitrile under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Acetonitrile is treated with aqueous acid and heat. Which major organic product forms after workup? Acidic hydrolysis of a nitrile gives a carboxylic acid after workup. The nitrile carbon becomes the carboxyl carbon, so the carbon count stays at two.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
